outcomeNote: A mnemonic only; nothing is argued.

segments.he: סִימָן: מַעֲשִׂים, צְדָקָה, קׇרְבָּן, כֹּהֵן, תַּעֲנִית, מִנְעָל, בַּרְזֶל.
segments.en: The Gemara prefaces the next discourse with «a mnemonic symbol: Deeds, charity, offering, priest, fast, shoe, iron.»

moves.cueHe: סימן: מעשים, צדקה, קרבן, כהן, תענית, מנעל, ברזל
moves.summary: The redactor supplies a mnemonic fixing the order of the seven dicta that follow (good deeds, charity, offering, priest, fast, shoe, iron).
